    {
      "question": "When the generated composite resolver is compiled with NETSTANDARD2_0 defined, is the ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute absent, and when it is not defined, is the attribute present?",
      "rationale": "The change test likely inspects raw generated text for a single build configuration; it does not verify that the preprocessor guard correctly includes or excludes the attribute under different target-framework compilation symbols."
    },
    {
      "question": "When the composite resolver is declared as a nested type, is the attribute emitted on the resolver class declaration and are the #if directives correctly balanced with the emitted namespace/nesting blocks?",
      "rationale": "The template emits nesting types and namespaces via TransformUtilities.EmitNestingTypesAndNamespaces; the change test and invariance cases likely use top-level resolvers and do not cover nested declarations where attribute placement could break syntax."
